verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a general v2 REST API with Bearer tokens, plus real-time visibility and custom reports. Nothing describes a structured identity event or audit log, an API endpoint for querying identity events, or native streaming to a SIEM. A generic REST API and dashboards are adjacent capabilities and do not deliver the story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, every identity event is queryable and exportable — a structured system log with API access and native streaming to my SIEM
